items.markdown:
Peptides are `short chains of amino acids that act as building blocks for vital skin proteins like collagen and elastin`.[[1]](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/peptides-for-skin)

### What Peptides Do for Your Skin

- **Stimulate Collagen & Elastin:** They signal your skin cells to rebuild structural proteins, which helps reduce fine lines and improve firmness over time.[[1]](https://www.adventhealth.com/blogs/what-are-peptides-skin-care)[[2]](https://optimadermatology.com/2025/09/26/the-truth-about-peptides-in-skincare)
- **Support Moisture & Barrier:** Many peptide formulas are combined with ingredients like hyaluronic acid to plump and hydrate the skin.[[1]](https://optimadermatology.com/2025/09/26/the-truth-about-peptides-in-skincare)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:15474320564230156004,catalogid:15366446604106546830,gpcid:42175154390984629,mid:576462746445076156&ibp=oshop)
- **Calm Inflammation:** They help lower skin oxidative stress and soothe minor irritation.[[1]](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/peptides-for-skin)[[2]](https://optimadermatology.com/2025/09/26/the-truth-about-peptides-in-skincare)

### Main Types of Peptides

- **Signal Peptides:** Tell the skin to produce more collagen (e.g., Matrixyl 3000, Matrixyl synthe'6).[[1]](https://www.vogue.com/article/best-peptide-skincare)[[2]](https://www.adventhealth.com/blogs/what-are-peptides-skin-care)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:15474320564230156004,catalogid:15366446604106546830,gpcid:42175154390984629,mid:576462746445076156&ibp=oshop)
- **Carrier Peptides:** Deliver trace minerals like copper to boost repair and healing (e.g., copper tripeptides / GHK-Cu).[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T4x-Vgax6iQ)[[2]](https://www.adventhealth.com/blogs/what-are-peptides-skin-care)[[3]](https://www.vogue.com/article/best-peptide-skincare)[[4]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:11734438442309332888,catalogid:8231338246013861331,gpcid:12456434822688567040,mid:576462658933522280&ibp=oshop)
- **Neurotransmitter Inhibitor Peptides:** Relax facial muscle movements to smooth expression lines (e.g., Acetyl Hexapeptide-8 / Argireline, SYN-AKE).[[1]](https://www.adventhealth.com/blogs/what-are-peptides-skin-care)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:15474320564230156004,catalogid:15366446604106546830,gpcid:42175154390984629,mid:576462746445076156&ibp=oshop)
- **Enzyme-Inhibitor Peptides:** Protect existing collagen from breaking down.[[1]](https://www.adventhealth.com/blogs/what-are-peptides-skin-care)

### Popular Skincare Products & Pricing
Add to list A multi-technology age-supporting serum priced around **$19.90**.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:15474320564230156004,catalogid:15366446604106546830,gpcid:42175154390984629,mid:576462746445076156&ibp=oshop)Add to list A targeted firming serum priced around **$10.90**.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:17812803496280378351,catalogid:10430321569440306035,gpcid:3356778343313545632,mid:576462341840448999&ibp=oshop)Add to list A blend of peptides and copper tripeptides priced around **$12.00**.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:11734438442309332888,catalogid:8231338246013861331,gpcid:12456434822688567040,mid:576462658933522280&ibp=oshop)Show more

### Tips for Using Peptides

- **Consistency is Key:** Visible results for firmness and fine lines typically take **8 to 12 weeks** of daily use.
- **Layering:** Peptides generally layer well with hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, and ceramides. Avoid mixing strong direct acids or high-strength vitamin C in the exact same step if they disrupt the pH or formula stability.[[1]](https://theordinary.com/en-us/blog/peptides-skincare-essential-guide.html)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:15474320564230156004,catalogid:15366446604106546830,gpcid:42175154390984629,mid:576462746445076156&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://optimadermatology.com/2025/09/26/the-truth-about-peptides-in-skincare)[[4]](https://www.adventhealth.com/blogs/what-are-peptides-skin-care)
